plan.task: Prompt 06 isolated part controls; no candidate evaluation or selection

role_rationale.jfe2140_vendor: Ordinary documented dual JFET; low-current input and mismatch gap
role_rationale.lsk170a_vendor: Independent manufacturer and low-Idss ordinary grade
role_rationale.pmbt5551_vendor: High-voltage NPN power/output DC and parasitics
role_rationale.bc850c_vendor: Ordinary bipolar input alternative; NF is separate from HV merit
role_rationale.opa928_vendor: Femtoampere CMOS guard and supply-current alternative

hypotheses: Vendor equations may disagree with guaranteed DC/capacitance or conditioned typical noise.
Matched-dual nominal halves cannot establish worst-case mismatch robustness.
A grounded CMOS follower may converge while floating integration remains unsupported.
Ordinary high-voltage BJT ratings do not establish low-noise input performance or SOA.

conditions.jfet: VDS10V transfer at -10/25/50C; 100uA/2mA voltage noise at 10Hz/1kHz, both original and refined grids; 5V transfer for current-noise condition; LSK capacitance at VDS15V/100uA/1MHz; leakage at documented reverse gate conditions
conditions.bipolar: VCE5V transfer at -10/25/50C; 100uA/1mA/2mA/10mA samples; NF at 200uA, Rs2kohm, VCE5V, local density screen1kHz; integrated10Hz-15.7kHz is an unvalidated diagnostic, BC850C specification uses B200Hz; collector capacitance VCB10V/1MHz; PMBT collector leakage120V at25/100C; P48 sensitivity52V/2mA with isothermal temperature102C from 500K/W and50C ambient
conditions.opa: Grounded unity follower; supplies5/16/36V with allowed common mode, temperatures-10/25/50C; guard no load; noise at100Hz/1kHz; guide GMIN1e-16 recorded explicitly; overload/floating/candidate behavior deferred
conditions.diode: One native diode from dual package; reverse75V at25/50C, capacitance0V1MHz; no unreferenced transient recovery rating

oracles: Conditioned datasheet limits and typical references in references.yaml
NF source reference 4*k*T*Rs; capacitor observer C=Im(I)/(2*pi*f)
Gate noise observer is a noiseless1ohm current-to-voltage source
Noise/AC refinement must agree within existing1percent; typical accuracy uses existing20percent only as disagreement screen
plan.variation: Deterministic coupled conditions; no random specimen selection, production probability or invented distributions
plan.stopping: One final finite child3 pass, max100jobs and15s per job unchanged; preserve all errors; no further retries/fitting or microphone promotion.
plan.parents: Existing device library experiments remain retained; new model IDs are independent manufacturer documents, not repairs of old models.
plan.preservation: Freeze shared source/models/spec/plan before evaluation; immutable results/device_models record; hash originals and verify private capture/restore
repairs: Keep all6devices and adverse bias/temperature grids unchanged; save live stdout outside source manifest
LSK170A remove only non-electrical MFG metadata; retain supported NLEV3/GDSNOI8 per ngspice manual; original remains
BAV199 remove unmatched global ENDS; native diode parameters unchanged; original remains
